sub_parameters.name: RefreshConfigType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the configuration. Valid values:

*   **0**: server synchronization task
*   **1**: cloud service synchronization task
*   **2**: scheduled AccessKey pair verification task

sub_parameters.name: SchedulePeriod
sub_parameters.description:
The synchronization cycle. Valid values:

*   **60**: 60 minutes
*   **180**: 3 hours
*   **360**: 6 hours
*   **720**: 12 hours
*   **1440**: 1 day
*   **10080**: 7 days

sub_parameters.name: Status
sub_parameters.description:
The status of the configuration. Valid values:

*   **1**: enabled
*   **0**: disabled

sub_parameters.name: TargetId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the data entry containing the AccessKey pair that you specify when you configure the scheduled AccessKey pair verification task.

sub_parameters.name: Vendor
sub_parameters.description:
The service provider of the cloud asset. Valid values:

*   **3**: Tencent Cloud
*   **4**: Huawei Cloud
*   **7**: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which your Security Center service resides.
